notes: UI polish + professional Analytics upgrade (v1.11.22): (0) data audit first — every new number is computed only from really stored data (planned minutes, current done flags, recorded actual/useful seconds, test totals, dated testLog deltas, the single Maz stage-4 result); a true backlog trend over time is NOT computable (no per-box tick dates) and is never shown. First/second-half comparisons (quality execution trend, useful trend, per-subject trend, insights) use the ELAPSED part of the range only, second half capped at TODAY — comparing full-range halves counted future boxes and made every completion trend look like a collapse.
